description: Deep runtime scored eligible held-out English documents. Hewlett is the US comparison cohort. TOEFL estimates cover eligible essays only.

band_control.method: one-sided class-zero order statistic on rounded index

source_provenance.language: English; production Deep admission on all four documents
source_provenance.selection_method: Seed 42. Only singleton source components from the original five datasets, PERSUADE control corpus and both new shards. One human rewrite, one machine rewrite and both exact clean parents per source. Stress draws first from stack-training sources absent from prior fits.
source_provenance.document_identity: Each .id is SHA-256 of casefolded, whitespace-collapsed UTF-8 text. The full projection binds each document's exact UTF-8 SHA-256, publisher/parent IDs, word count, generator, group, role and domain.

role_support.selection_rule: Same declared scientific field; maximum-cardinality 1:1 groups by role at <=1.25 length ratio, then minimum absolute log length distance.

preflight_rejections.basis: Peak 13866459488 bytes in the 4-bit validation run, plus the change in packed pair size: 2 * (8091987725 - 4284346255) bytes. Shard sizes from mlx-community/Qwen2.5-7B-8bit@7c80b674e40cfecdfde930919cd7bbceafa17aea and its Instruct-8bit counterpart @df11cb390bd674c24a9ddedf19f05bc09f6e0148. Assumes similar non-weight memory.

report.method: nearest-rank p95, one excluded warm-up per mode
